title: Welcome to Dorley Hall
creator: Alyson Greaves
why_it_matters: This belongs in the library as a live reading-pressure candidate rather than a settled influence. It sits near current interests in trans fiction, institutional structures, coercion and care, identity reshaping, and emotionally charged social systems. Even before deeper engagement, it already occupies the kind of conceptual neighborhood that is likely to matter.
why_now: It should be present now because the library needs not only established returning influences, but also live future-reading pressure. This is one of the books worth holding in view as a probable source of thematic and emotional relevance.
active_questions: What kinds of institutional and relational structures does it make visible?
How does it handle coercion, care, and transformation without flattening them into one moral register?
What kind of emotional and stylistic pressure does it exert once actually read?
signals: Important as a future-reading pressure item rather than a settled influence entry.
Useful contrast case against the already-returning sources in the library.
notes: This should probably deepen or change materially once it is actually read rather than just held in view.
A good example of a library item that matters before it becomes a finished influence.
